title: variant.create_from, contract version 1
description: Creates a language's variant of an entry from a revision of another language's variant (PRD 9.2, 10.3): the entry, the new variant, the source variant, the number of the source's revision and the version of the source variant the caller read. The new variant's first revision is a copy of the source revision's fields, and the kernel records the derivation translated_from, which a later release of the source with other content marks stale. A new variant the entry has already, or a source at another version, is version_conflict, and the command is authorized in the new variant's locale. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Entries\Domain\Commands\CreateVariantFrom, and the generated codec CreateVariantFromCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

revision.description: The number of the source variant's revision to copy.

source.description: The locale of the variant the new variant is translated from.

variant.description: The locale of the new variant, which the entry does not have yet.

version.description: The version of the source variant the caller read.

locale.description: A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.

revision.description: The number of a revision of a variant, an integer of 1 or more.

version.description: The version of an aggregate that the caller read, an integer of 1 or more; the command is version_conflict when the aggregate is at another version when it commits.
